entities.summary: Prince Yakov Gerasimovich Bagratuni was a Russian and Armenian nobleman and military commander. He was a major general in the Imperial Russian Army. During World War I, he served under the Centro-Caspian Dictatorship and the First Republic of Armenia and later became the Ambassador of Armenia to Great Britain.
